latePresentationChange.detail: Synchronous request failures now preserve the planner error instead of replacing it with Deploy first.

discoveredFailure.cause: Slate cleared edit focus after Enter, so the panel stopped receiving Tab.
discoveredFailure.correction: Preserve keyboard focus on commit; real Slate input rerun verifies Tab and Esc.

limitations: Twelve model calls use synthetic observations and short commands; no win-rate, broad intelligence or balance inference.
Slate keyboard events are synthetic engine input; physical keyboard, Chinese IME, button clicks, Alt-Tab and human usability were not tested.
Actual cloud game probes verify accepted capture plan, real movement, manual override and restart; they cancel before claiming the full capture/guard plan completed.
Fault probe uses disclosed HTTP fixtures, normal pause and public planner API; it is not model inference.
Final Shipping was built/cooked and statically checked, not manually played.
No online learning, RAG, reinforcement training, voice, new art assets or long performance benchmark.
Cloud API needs network and configured credentials; no local model is bundled.
Public release remains v1.0; this upgrade is local.
